title: Tehran - September 21 - The spokesperson for the Iranian Parliament's National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, Hassan Ghashghavi made remarks in an interview today.
text:
Tehran - September 21 - The spokesperson for the Iranian Parliament's National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, Hassan Ghashghavi made remarks in an interview today."

""

"SOT1, Hassan Ghashghavi, National Security and Foreign Policy Commission (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:47): "Unless our seven conditions, based on the Islamabad statement, are met, it is impossible for the Strait of Hormuz to be opened. The Strait of Hormuz is closed, contrary to the claims of the CENTCOM commander, who yesterday pulled the other one, saying that one billion barrels of oil has been exported and Iran couldn't export even one barrel. These are 100% lies, just as our Armed Forces spokesperson said. We receive daily reports in the commission regarding the status of the Strait of Hormuz; for example, the unauthorized passage of three or four ships compared to 135 ships [Daily] before the war does not mean that the Strait of Hormuz has been opened.""

""
"SOT2, Hassan Ghashghavi, National Security and Foreign Policy Commission (Farsi) (00:48 - 01:13): "If the Strait of Hormuz is open, so why have oil and diesel prices reached this level in America? Why has the global price of oil increased? Let me explain: the US Federal Reserve has raised interest rates to mop up liquidity and control the inflation existing in America. These things do not align with those claims.
